description: Defines the API and inline functions for sensor emulator backend, including function pointers for setting channels, getting sample ranges, setting attributes, and retrieving attribute metadata.

methods.name: emul_sensor_backend_is_supported
methods.description: Checks if a sensor emulator supports the backend API.

methods.name: emul_sensor_backend_set_channel
methods.description: Sets an expected value for a sensor channel on an emulator.

methods.name: emul_sensor_backend_get_sample_range
methods.description: Retrieves the supported sample value range and tolerance for a sensor channel.

methods.name: emul_sensor_backend_set_attribute
methods.description: Sets attribute values for a sensor emulator.

methods.name: emul_sensor_backend_get_attribute_metadata
methods.description: Gets metadata about a sensor attribute, including min, max, and increment values.
